Phase 2: check diagnostics (cv_r2); if model trustworthy, exploit via logei; use ucb/std for unexplored corners if needed. Phase 3: local refinement around best (trust region) for final evaluations. Track expectations vs observations to calibrate trust.

After 3 Sobol points: y = 21.326, 21.062, 21.528 at distant corners. Landscape is very flat: signal_std ~0.21, noise_std ~0.02 (model fits the 3 points almost perfectly, cv_r2 still negative with n=3). Lengthscales all long (~0.4-0.7) = slow variation. Hypothesis: function is near-constant ~21.3 with small structure; minimum so far 21.062 (trial 1). Plan: continue space-filling (Sobol) through ~10 points, watch for any dip below ~20 or sharp gradients, then switch to exploitation once cv_r2 is meaningful.

n=8: cv_r2=0.24 (mild trust). Landscape flat overall (y range 20.76-21.86, signal_std 0.34). Sensitive params: x_a30 (sens 0.22, ls 0.30), x_d6b (0.21, 0.31), x_38c (0.12, 0.56); x_68a/x_823/x_1ee nearly inert (ls>1). Best: trial 3 y=20.761 at x_a30~0.07, x_d6b~0.40, x_38c~0.36, x_823~0.02. Plan: exploit logei in the low-x_a30/low-x_68a/low-x_823 cluster (2-3 evals), then local trust-region refinement around best, keep 1-2 global hedges. Expected global min likely ~20.3-20.7; improvements are small.

Calibration break: pm-min predicted 20.341±0.07, observed 20.853 (t10). t9 (20.66) and t10 (20.85) are close to t8 (20.346) but much worse -> the well around t8 is narrower than the GP lengthscales; local GP means overfit to t8. Trust local GP NO. New plan: hand-crafted single/double-parameter probes at step ~0.1 around t8 to map the well, plus interleaved global space-filling hedges (function may have other wells; background ~21.2-21.9, best-so-far dips at low x_a30/x_823). Budget: 19 left; plan ~8-10 local probes + ~4-6 global hedges, end on best-known point.

FINAL (30 evals). Campaign summary: space-filling found the broad ~21 plateau; single-probe mapping pinned x_c72 dip (~0.61-0.64) and x_f6b (~0.85); joint GP moves produced the breakthroughs (t23 19.772, t26 19.565). The basin is narrow (RMS 0.05 neighbors 0.4-1.0 worse) and the GP is systematically optimistic by ~0.05-0.1 near the optimum, so late refinement used small, anchored steps. Final incumbent: t26 y=19.5654 at x_17c 0.6797, x_1ee 0.4710, x_38c 0.2118, x_68a 0.3052, x_7b4 0.1748, x_823 0, x_a30 0.2289, x_c72 0.6094, x_d6b 0.6599, x_f6b 0.8726. Last eval: parabola vertex through t25(19.759), t26(19.565), t27(20.575) at s~0.86 of t25->t26, 0.02 RMS from incumbent.
